Hi Jordan,

Quick context: our engineering team hit an unexpected blocker with the third-party identity provider used by our on-prem connector. They pushed a schema change last week that broke our auth handshake and the fix is larger than we expected — we need another 2-3 sprints to validate and re-run end-to-end tests.

Because of that delay we won't be able to complete the PoC and the user demo slated for Nov 18. The product team is concerned about losing momentum with our execs.

Could Redwood provide a 30-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit bundle (~$1,000) so our engineers can continue offline validation while we sort the integration? If you need logs, I attached the client-side error trace.

Attachments: integration-error-log.txt (text/plain)

Appreciate any help — we really like the throughput and the latency numbers so far, and want to keep this moving.

Best,
